parameters.query:
WITH freed AS (
  UPDATE topic_slots SET post_id = NULL, execution_id = NULL, locked_at = NULL, expires_at = NULL
  WHERE post_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < now()
  RETURNING slot_no, post_id
),
freed_audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
  SELECT 'topic', f.post_id, 'slot_expired_released', 'system', jsonb_build_object('slot_no', f.slot_no), 'LinkedIn Content - Daily Maintenance', $1
  FROM freed f
  RETURNING id
),
day_start AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS d,
         (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS w
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM freed)::int AS slots_freed,
  (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(post_id, ', '), '') FROM freed) AS freed_topics,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM topic_slots WHERE post_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at >= now())::int AS slots_busy,
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(cost_usd), 0) FROM cost_ledger, day_start WHERE created_at >= day_start.d)::float AS spend_today_usd,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT post_id) FROM cost_ledger, day_start WHERE created_at >= day_start.d)::int AS topics_charged_today,
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(cost_usd), 0) FROM cost_ledger, day_start WHERE created_at >= day_start.w)::float AS spend_week_usd,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('post_id', post_id, 'spent_usd', spent_usd::float, 'budget_usd', budget_usd::float) ORDER BY spent_usd DESC), '[]'::json)
     FROM topic_budget WHERE spent_usd >= budget_usd AND updated_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS over_budget,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('post_id', post_id, 'spent_usd', spent_usd::float, 'budget_usd', budget_usd::float) ORDER BY spent_usd DESC), '[]'::json)
     FROM topic_budget WHERE spent_usd >= 0.8 * budget_usd AND spent_usd < budget_usd AND updated_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS near_budget
